L5-01.why: Real: the in-lane check only refuses permit.deadline<=now. The permit is outside the sweep signature and the quote MAC, and the contract swallows a failed permit, so a permit that lapses before inclusion gives a mined revert the relayer pays for. The strike is recorded only afterwards. Not High for the beta: the loss is relayer gas, capped by the loss and daily budgets. The 429-for-everyone result needs about 10 gwei per revert. That is far above Base Sepolia prices, and the relayer is opt-in (relayerUrl '').
L5-01.fix: Refuse when permit.deadline < sweep.deadline, reusing permit_expired (already a PRE_BROADCAST class), at service.ts:573 or in validation. Add no margin: web sweep.ts:169,247 and hops execute.ts:61-84 sign permit.deadline == sweep.deadline, so '+margin' would reject every honest request. The sweep deadline (>now+30 s) then bounds the window.

L5-02.why: Real: all users share the global loss cap. Once it is spent, every sweep gets 429 for the window, mined reverts stay breaker-neutral and healthz stays ok. It is worse than stated: the global cap is reserved and settled once per key (dst+net), so it trips at half the configured loss. Medium, not High: the cap fails closed by design and is alerted. With beta-chain gas and the example budget it needs far more reverts per hour than a one-tx-per-receipt lane can send. It is only cheap at L1-like gas.
L5-02.fix: Charge the global cap once per sweep: reserve it separately from the per-key reservations. Keep a slice of the global cap for sources with no loss in the window, so one source group cannot 429 everyone. Alert or degrade health on a sustained mined_revert rate. Fixing L5-01 removes the cheap source of reverts.

L5-06.why: Real: on a receipt timeout the daily-budget reservation is kept until UTC midnight, and both loss-budget reservations until the window ends. The lane is held for receiptTimeoutSeconds, and nothing bumps the fee or cancels. The breaker already recorded success at broadcast, so healthz stays ok. Medium: breaker and health silently miss stuck txs, and a stall needs a fee spike or sequencer stall. Budget exhaustion is negligible at beta gas; the main effect is a silent stall.
L5-06.fix: After a receipt timeout, record a breaker failure explicitly and alert. The job's permit is already settled at broadcast, so a setOutcome there is too late. Keep the reservation in a pending ledger that a later receipt lookup releases. Replace-by-fee or cancel the head nonce.

Funds stuck, not lost. (b) and (c) are outside the beta.
